title: Questions 156-157 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
Please be advised that the escalators between the second and third floors of Meridian House will be temporarily out of service on 9 March. During a routine safety inspection this morning, a fault was found in one of the drive units. It was subsequently established that the escalators need a control board that must be ordered from the manufacturer.

To keep everyone safe, the escalators will be shut off while the repair work is carried out. All staff and visitors must therefore use the passenger lifts or the main staircase to move between floors on 9 March. We apologise for the inconvenience.
